+def _char_width(ch: str) -> int:
+    if unicodedata.combining(ch):
+        return 0
+    return 2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(ch) in ("W", "F") else 1
+
+
+def _width(text: str) -> int:
+    """Terminal columns: wide (CJK, fullwidth) characters take two."""
+    return sum(_char_width(c) for c in text)
+
+
+class _WideWrapper(textwrap.TextWrapper):
+    """TextWrapper that measures columns instead of characters."""
+
+    def _split(self, text):
+        # Allow a break between wide characters, which are not space-separated.
+        out = []
+        for chunk in super()._split(text):
+            if chunk.strip() and any(_char_width(c) == 2 for c in chunk):
+                cur = ""
+                for c in chunk:
+                    if _char_width(c) == 2:
+                        if cur:
+                            out.append(cur)
+                        out.append(c)
+                        cur = ""
+                    else:
+                        cur += c
+                if cur:
+                    out.append(cur)
+            else:
+                out.append(chunk)
+        return out
+
+    def _handle_long_word(self, reversed_chunks, cur_line, cur_len, width):
+        space_left = 1 if width < 1 else width - cur_len
+        chunk = reversed_chunks[-1]
+        take = ""
+        for c in chunk:
+            if _width(take + c) > space_left:
+                break
+            take += c
+        if not take and not cur_line:  # char wider than the line: emit it anyway
+            take = chunk[0]
+        if self.break_on_hyphens and len(take) < len(chunk):
+            hyphen = take.rfind("-")
+            if hyphen > 0 and any(c != "-" for c in take[:hyphen]):
+                take = take[: hyphen + 1]
+        if self.break_long_words:
+            cur_line.append(take)
+            reversed_chunks[-1] = chunk[len(take):]
+        elif not cur_line:
+            cur_line.append(reversed_chunks.pop())
+
+    def _wrap_chunks(self, chunks):
+        lines = []
+        width = self.width
+        chunks.reverse()
+        while chunks:
+            cur_line = []
+            cur_len = 0
+            indent = self.subsequent_indent if lines else self.initial_indent
+            avail = width - _width(indent)
+            if self.drop_whitespace and chunks[-1].strip() == "" and lines:
+                del chunks[-1]
+            while chunks:
+                w = _width(chunks[-1])
+                if cur_len + w <= avail:
+                    cur_line.append(chunks.pop())
+                    cur_len += w
+                else:
+                    break
+            if chunks and _width(chunks[-1]) > avail:
+                self._handle_long_word(chunks, cur_line, cur_len, avail)
+                cur_len = _width("".join(cur_line))
+            if self.drop_whitespace and cur_line and cur_line[-1].strip() == "":
+                cur_len -= _width(cur_line[-1])
+                del cur_line[-1]
+            if cur_line:
+                lines.append(indent + "".join(cur_line))
+        return lines
+
+
 def wrap(text: str, width: int = 72) -> str:
